title: Joe Williams's faith in Jones and the albums he arranged
summary: Joe Williams supported Jones's writing, which led to more work; Jones counts five or six albums and many arrangements.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: Yeah. Now Billy never uses a piano, you know. It can hang you up, that kind of writing. But getting back to Joe Williams, oh, I have to say not only is he a great personal friend, but a great professional friend. He had a lot of faith in me when a lot of people weren't paying much attention.
I know he has always spoken highly of you and very enthusiastically about your writing.
Yes. He's had a lot of faith in me, and I just have to give him credit, in that once our things began -- became successful on records, you know, then a lot of people
What are the things that you've done for Joe?
Let me see, can I say it by albums?

One, two, three, four, five, six, seven -- now this is not -- this doesn't count TV. Or just the scores I send to him that he uses, you know. Five or six albums, you know. Now, when you think of 12 tunes an album, that's a whole lot of work.

Yes. 'Joe Williams Sings' -- oh, let me see how my memory is here. It goes back to Roulette Records. 'Joe Williams Sings to You.' That's the title. There was another one. Gee, now, I wish Joe was here because he has a very sharp memory.
